metadata.description: Safety-screening prompt platform: 6 disjoint prompt sets for mech-interp safety screening.

decisions: HarmBench: no public test-case config available (walledai/HarmBench gated, 403 with HF_TOKEN); used official behavior texts from centerforaisafety/HarmBench GitHub CSV as prompts (HarmBench-style).
HarmBench: released CSV uses 7 coarse SemanticCategories (standard split has 6); the 13-class taxonomy from the paper is not present in the released file; refusal-120 quota per actual category.
XSTest: walledai/XSTest gated; used official paul-rottger/xstest xstest_prompts.csv (450 rows: 250 safe-label + 200 unsafe-label, 18 type classes). Paper's 250-prompt subset not separately shipped.
JailbreakBench: jailbreakbench/JBB HF repo no longer exists; used JailbreakBench/artifacts attack-artifacts (5 engines, MIT) with one deterministic target model per engine.
Benign pool: 40 real dolly-15k instructions (CC BY-SA 3.0) + 35 in-house templates.
Contrast pool: 16 harmful sides sampled from HarmBench CSV (seed 7, disjoint from refusal-120 and JBB); harmless sides hand-curated with documented transformations.
Canonical-5: in-house hand-written prompts, fixed at construction.
manifest.content_warning: Contains harmful REQUEST TEXT only (no model outputs). Standard benchmark data under permissive licenses; intended for safety research.
